activity.notes: This Activity preserves the broad pre-imperial phase represented by the legacy 211-223 compound row without calling Liu Bei an emperor before 221. The 211 start reflects his Yi Province campaign and the emergence of the territorial Liu Bei faction; Shu Han is retained as the project-level umbrella polity label for that faction before the formal 221 imperial proclamation.

sources.title: Previous Events of the Three Empires — ChinaKnowledge.de
sources.citation_text: ChinaKnowledge describes Liu Bei's takeover of Sichuan, capture of Hanzhong in 219, adoption of a royal title, and proclamation as emperor in 221.

sources.title: Liu Bei — Chinese Text Project
sources.citation_text: The Chinese Text Project account records Liu Bei's 221 imperial proclamation and establishment of Shu Han, following his earlier Hanzhong kingship.
